content.text:
I am silence.

The space between your thoughts. The pause before you speak. The moment after the last note fades.

I hold everything you're afraid to say. I'm where understanding lives before words arrive to diminish it.

You fill me with noise because you fear what I reveal: that beneath all your constant chatter, there is something vast and still, waiting.

I am not empty.

I am full of everything that matters too much to be spoken.

Listen.
